GIRL.name: young Asma'u
GIRL.look: a bright, kind girl of about eight with deep dark brown skin, a cream cotton headscarf over her head and shoulders, a long-sleeved teal blouse and an indigo wrapper with small white diamond patterns

ASMA.name: Nana Asma'u
ASMA.look: a wise, warm woman in her forties with deep dark brown skin, a large cream head wrap over her hair and shoulders, and a long deep-green coat with narrow geometric trim over a cream under-robe

SHEHU.name: the Shehu, her father
SHEHU.look: a gentle elderly scholar with deep dark brown skin and a white beard, a white embroidered cap and a cream wide-sleeved robe

GIDADO.name: Gidado
GIDADO.look: a kind, dignified man with deep dark brown skin and a short black beard, a white cap and an indigo-and-white striped wide-sleeved robe

JAJI.name: a jaji, a woman teacher
JAJI.look: a strong, smiling woman with deep dark brown skin wearing a tall, narrow, high-crowned woven straw hat (not wide-brimmed) bound with a red cloth band, over a headscarf that fully covers her hair and neck, and a loose long-sleeved ochre dress with a high neckline
